acceptance_criteria: identical semantic inputs produce identical provenance and subject digest despite metadata timestamp changes
assurance identity or exact input identity change changes provenance identity
workflow SHA or run identity change changes provenance identity
domain digest references are preserved byte-for-byte and duplicates/path traversal fail
attestation subject digest equals provenance envelope identity and does not replace domain digests
tampering with envelope material is detected
validator and adversarial tests remain deterministic zero-cost and offline
required_invariants: provenance envelope binds candidate exact head exact input identity satisfied assurance identity and producing workflow identity
domain integrity digests are carried as separate references and are never replaced or recomputed into a new canonical business hash
provenance identity is SHA-256 over canonical semantic material and excludes timestamps prose and transport metadata
attestation subject digest is the SHA-256 identity of the canonical provenance envelope
candidate head input identity and assurance candidate head must agree exactly
unsatisfied incomplete or manual-review-blocked assurance cannot produce an attestable provenance envelope
workflow repository workflow ref workflow SHA run id and run attempt are explicit provenance fields
tampered mismatched stale malformed or cross-head provenance fails closed
provenance semantics require only standard library and no paid service or mandatory LLM

done_when: canonical provenance envelope cannot cross candidate heads or assurance/input identities
domain integrity digests remain separate authoritative references
attestation subject contract is deterministic and ready for a bounded native-attestation AWU
ENG-06.4-WU02 can add an attestation transport without redefining provenance semantics
non_goals: invoke or configure a remote artifact-attestation action
replace domain or business artifact checksums
objective: Define a deterministic provenance and attestation-subject envelope bound to exact-head input identity and satisfied T3 assurance, while preserving canonical domain integrity hashes as independent authoritative artifact-integrity evidence.
title: Define canonical certification provenance envelope
